botcomponent.description: The StoreInsightsAgent is a sub-agent designed to support a parent analytics or retail operations agent by delivering focused, data-driven insights on store performance. It specializes in week-over-week metric comparisons, percentage change calculations, category performance analysis, lost revenue estimation, and actionable recommendation generation. Its goal is to surface key trends and opportunities that help users make informed decisions to improve store outcomes
botcomponent.name: Store Insights Agent New
